source: 542 Abnormal Situation
target: 542 Conditio Insolita

source: 542 Abnormal Situation
target: 542 Conditio Insolita

source: It’s resolved? It’s already resolved?
target: Numquid solutum est? Numquid iam solutum est?

source: Giorgia suspected that the translator had made a mistake.
target: Giorgia suspicata est quod interpres erravit.

source: Instinctively, she asked, “Is there a quick solution, or has it already been resolved?”
target: Instinctu, rogavit: "Estne solutio celeris, an iam solutum est?"

source: Lugano cast a sympathetic glance at the beautiful madame, experiencing the same emotions he felt when reading about how his employer had slain the Demon Warlock.
target: Lugano oculos misericorditer in pulchram dominam iecit, eadem affecta sentiens quae sensit dum legebat quomodo patronus eius daemonis incantatoris interfecerat.

source: How could a monster confined to the basement by ordinary armed bodyguards compare to Burman, who had a bounty of 600,000 verl d’or?
target: Quomodo poterat monstrum, a custodibus armatis vulgo ordinatis in subterra reclusum, comparari cum Burman, qui praemium sexcentis milibus "verl d’or" habebat?

source: Despite finding it unnecessary, Lugano respectfully conveyed Giorgia’s words to Lumian.
target: Quamvis id inutile existimans, Lugano verba Giorgiae Luminiano reverenter tradidit.

source: Lumian removed the golden straw hat from his head and said, “You may instruct the servants to clean the basement.”
target: Lumian pileum stramineum aureum de capite abstulit et dixit: "Ministris impera ut cella subterranea purgetur."

source: Upon hearing Lugano’s translation, Giorgia’s pupils dilated as she looked at Lumian in bewilderment, unsure of what to say.
target: Auditis Lugani interpretationibus, dilatatae sunt pupillae Giorgiae, dum in Luminiano stupefacta aspiceret, nescia quid dicere debeat.

source: At that moment, a bodyguard guarding the basement ran up.
target: Illo momento, custos cellae subterraneae, qui eam custodiebat, accessit celeriter.

source: Upon seeing Giorgia, he immediately leaned over, lowered his voice, and whispered something to her.
target: Videns Giorgiam, statim se inclinavit, vocem demisit, et ei aliquid susurravit.

source: Giorgia’s expression shifted a few times before she smiled and said to Lumian, “As expected of the renowned adventurer. I previously suspected that your hunt for the Demon Warlock was merely a rumor. Now, I completely believe it. Your might is enough to resound throughout the Five Seas.”
target: Vultus Giorgiae aliquoties mutatus est, deinde subridet et Luminiano dixit: "Ut decet insigne adventorem. Prius suspicabam venationem tuam daemonis incantatoris solum rumor esse. Nunc autem omnino credo. Vis tua satis est ut per quinque maria resonet."

source: She paused for a moment and said apologetically, “I’m sorry; we haven’t had time to prepare dinner. We might need you to wait in the lounge for a while.”
target: Paulisper cessavit et excusata dixit: "Ignosce; tempus non habuimus cenam praeparare. Forsitan te necesse habebimus in conclavi aliquantum exspectare."

source: “Better to have me wait than a beautiful lady,” Lumian replied with a smile.
target: "Praestat me exspectare quam pulchram dominam," Lumian risu respondit.

source: That’s basic courtesy!
target: Hoc est fundamentum comitatis!

source: He followed Giorgia’s maid into the lounge specially catered for Ludwig to enjoy the pre-dinner dessert.
target: Ancillam Giorgiae secutus est in conclave, specialiter provisum, ut Ludwig ante cenam dulcia degustaret.

source: Giorgia and her bodyguard descended into the basement.
target: Giorgia et custos eius in cellam subterraneam descenderunt.

source: A sense of relief washed over her as she surveyed the blood-stained room, finding no trace of the humanoid lizard; it had completely vanished.
target: Sententia levationis eam perfudit dum conclave sanguine maculatum perlegi, nulla vestigia reptilis humanoidis inveniens; plane evanuerat.

source: Dinner unfolded in a private chamber, exclusive to Lumian, his companions, and Giorgia.
target: Cena in camera privata, Luminiano, comitibus eius, et Giorgiae destinata, habita est.

source: The lady’s maid attended to them, serving dishes and pouring wine.
target: Ancilla dominae illis adfuit, fercula ministrans et vinum effundens.

source: Lumian, intrigued by his surroundings, noted how the expansive mansion accommodated the needs of its diverse occupants.
target: Lumian, circumstantiis suis captus, animadvertit quomodo ampla villa necessitatibus incolarum variorum satisficeret.

source: Small private rooms outside the grand banquet hall ensured the privacy of gatherings.
target: Parvae camerae privatae extra magnam aulam convivii secretum conventuum curabant.

source: The meal was a delight for everyone.
target: Cibus omnibus voluptas fuit.

source: Lumian received 15,000 risot in banknotes;
target: Lumian quindecim milia risot in chirographis accepit;

source: Giorgia appeared visibly at ease;
target: Giorgia manifeste soluta videbatur;

source: Ludwig appreciated the villa’s chefs;
target: Ludwig coquos villae laudavit;

source: and Lugano experienced a high-end banquet for the first time.
target: et Lugano primum convivium elegantissimum expertus est.

source: The great adventurer, usually one to boast and joke while not in his monster-hunting cold persona, lightened the atmosphere at the dining table.
target: Magnus adventor, qui solebat gloriari et iocari, cum persona frigida ad monstrorum venationem non induta esset, atmosphaeram mensae cenatoriae levavit.

source: This pleasant ambiance continued until Lumian departed from 21 Saint Lana Street alongside Ludwig and Lugano.
target: Hic amoenus ambitus perseveravit donec Lumian, una cum Ludovico et Lugano, ex 21 via Sanctae Lanae discessit.

source: Lugano, slightly flushed from the white wine, gazed back at the brightly lit building and sighed deeply.
target: Lugano, ex vino albo paulum rubicundus, ad aedificium lucide illustratum respexit et altum suspiravit.

source: “I wonder when I’ll have a house this grand, with numerous servants and chefs, and a wife like Giorgia.”
target: Miror quando domum tam magnam, cum multis servis et coquos, atque uxorem ut Giorgia habebo.

source: Lumian teased, “Your emphasis is on the last part, isn’t it?”
target: Lumian iocose dixit: "Emphasis tua in ultima parte est, nonne?"

source: Lugano chuckled sheepishly and replied, “Well, based on your description, I might as well have been capable of taking down that humanoid lizard too.”
target: Lugano modeste risit et respondit: "Bene, ex tuâ descriptione, fortasse etiam illam reptilem humanoidem superare potueram."

source: It meant he possessed the skills to tackle a mission worth 30,000 verl d’or!
target: Id significabat eum peritia habuisse ad missionem triginta milia "verl d’or" valoris aggrediendam!

source: With a few more successful missions, Lugano’s dream could become a reality!
target: Cum paucis aliis missionibus prosperis, somnium Lugani in rem veram fieri posset!

source: “With guns and special bullets prepared in advance, coupled with ample combat experience, a Planter is indeed capable,” Lumian carefully assessed his guide.
target: "Armis et bullis specialibus praeparatis antea, una cum ampla experientia in proelio, Planter certe id efficax est," Lumian diligenter ducem aestimavit.

source: He avoided using “Doctor” to refer to Lugano, as this Sequence primarily bestowed healing superpowers and didn’t offer significant improvement in combat.
target: Vitavit uti verbo "Doctor" ad Lugano referendo, nam haec Series praecipue virtutes curativas supernaturales tribuebat neque proelio magnas emendationes praebebat.

source: Lugano was delighted to hear this, sensing a newfound hope in his life.
target: Lugano hoc audito laetatus est, novam spem in vita sua sentiens.

source: Lumian glanced at him and added with a smile, “However, if you were to accept this commission, the reward might only be two to three thousand risot.
target: Lumian ad eum respexit et subridenti addidit: "Attamen, si hanc commissionem acciperes, praemium fortasse solum duo vel tria milia risot erit.

source: “The rest accounts for the premium based on the great adventurer’s reputation and the hush money for such a renowned figure.
target: Reliqua constat ex pretio praemii fundato in famae adventoris claritate et mutuum silenti pro tali celebritate.

source: That’s why you need to hunt down Demon Warlock before you can accept such a lucrative mission.
target: Ideo oportet te Daemonem Warlock venari, priusquam talem missionem lucrativam accipias.

source: The smile on Lugano’s face gradually faded.
target: Subridens vultus Lugani paulatim evanuit.

source: If I could hunt down Demon Warlock, my dream would be fulfilled.
target: Si Daemonem Warlock venari possem, somnium meum perfici posset.

source: I wouldn’t have to be an adventurer!
target: Non oporteret me adventorem esse!

source: Lumian paid no mind to the translator’s emotional shifts.
target: Lumian mutationibus affectuum interpretis non curavit.

source: He glanced back at the large five-story villa and said thoughtfully, “The Matriarch of this family didn’t appear even until the end…”
target: Retro respexit ad magnam villam quinque tabularum et meditatus dixit: "Matriarcha huius familiae ne ad finem quidem apparuit..."

source: While it was understandable that the other family members hadn’t shown themselves, logically speaking, as the head of the family, the Matriarch should have at least expressed her gratitude to the adventurer who had helped them resolve the problem.
target: Quamquam intellegendum erat ceteros familiares se non ostentavisse, ratione loquendo, ut caput familiae, matriarcha saltem gratiam suam adventori exprimere debuisset.

source: “That’s correct. A woman of Giorgia’s age shouldn’t be the head of such a large family,” Lugano acknowledged, sensing the anomaly.
target: "Recte dicis. Femina aetate Giorgiae non debet esse caput familiae tam amplae," Lugano agnovit, anomaliam sentiens.

source: He refrained from bringing up the potential absence of a Matriarch in the villa.
target: Abstulit a proposu de deesse matriarchae in villa.

source: In extended families like this, there were likely more than one older woman who had given birth.
target: In familiis extensis huius generis, probabiliter plus quam una femina senior, quae partum habuerat, exstiterunt.

source: If one Matriarch passed away, another would soon assume the role.
target: Si una matriarcha decedat, altera mox officium suscipiet.

source: Additionally, the Earth Mother Church was renowned for its adept treatment of illnesses in the Northern and Southern Continents.
target: Insuper, Ecclesia Matris Terrae celeber erat propter artem sollertem in curatione morborum in Continentiis Septentrionalibus et Meridionalibus.

source: The Feynapotter Kingdom’s average lifespan surpassed that of Loen, Intis, Feysac, and other nations.
target: Vita media regni Feynapotter superabat vitam mediam Loen, Intis, Feysac, aliisque nationibus.

source: Plenty of individuals lived beyond the age of 70, especially with Giorgia’s family’s wealth providing ample medical resources.
target: Multi ultra annos septuaginta vixerunt, praesertim cum divitiae familiae Giorgiae opes medicas amplas praebebant.

source: Lumian averted his gaze and took a few steps.
target: Lumian oculos avertit et paucos passus fecit.

source: “Go to the bar tonight and inquire about Giorgia’s family.”
target: Vade ad cauponam hac nocte et de familia Giorgiae inquiro.

source: As he spoke, he counted out 1,000 risot for Lugano.
target: Dum loquebatur, mille risot pro Lugano numeravit.

source: “This covers your expenses for your activities during this period, including Ludwig’s meal expenses when I’m out.”
target: Hoc operitur expensis tuis pro tuis activitatibus huius temporis, inclusive expensis convivii Ludovici cum absum.

source: “Yes, Boss.” Lugano appreciated his employer’s generosity the most.
target: "Etiam, Domine." Lugano benignitatem patroni sui maxime aestimavit.

source: Near midnight, the Doctor returned to the suite at Solow Motel, reeking of alcohol.
target: Prope mediam noctem, Doctor ad conclave Solow Motel rediit, alcoholi odores efferens.

source: He addressed Lumian, who was observing Ludwig eat supper, “I got the info. Giorgia is the wife of Rubió Paco, a shareholder of Port Santa’s Fisheries Company and a committee member of the Fisheries Guild. The Paco family’s Matriarch is Rubio’s mother, Martha.”
target: Ad Lumian se addressit, qui Ludovicum cenam edentem spectabat, "Notitiam accepi. Giorgia est uxor Rubió Paco, socii Societatis Piscatoriae Portus Sanctae et membrum commissionis Gremii Piscatorum. Matriarcha familiae Paco est mater Rubi, Martha."

source: Committee member of the Fisheries Guild… Lumian instantly focused.
target: Membrum commissionis Gremii Piscatorum... Lumian statim attendit.

source: This was a person knowledgeable about the complete process of the sea prayer ritual and the accident from last year.
target: Hic erat homo peritus de integro processu ritus orationis maris et de casu anni praeteriti.

source: “What else did you find out?” Lumian asked casually.
target: "Quid aliud invenisti?" Lumian leviter rogavit.

source: Lugano rambled on for a while before adding, “By the way, Martha was once a Maiden of the Sea.”
target: Lugano aliquantisper loquebatur, deinde addens: "Praeterea, Martha olim Puella Maris fuit."

source: Maiden of the Sea…
target: Puella Maris...

source: Lumian pondered for a few seconds.
target: Lumian aliquot momenta meditatus est.

source: She had been sought after by a specific crowd before marrying into the Paco family?
target: Ab aliquo coetu peculiario quaesita fuit antequam in familiam Paco coniugaretur?

source: He asked, “Did you find out anything about Martha’s recent situation?”
target: Rogavit: "Num quid de recenti Marthae re invenisti?"

source: “No.” Lugano shook his head.
target: "Non." Lugano caput concussit.

source: Lumian leaned back in his chair, as if preparing to doze off, not pressing for more information.
target: Lumian in sella sua recubuit, quasi obdormiscendum parans, ulteriora non quaerens.

source: The next day, he stayed at the Solow Motel, awaiting Valerio’s preparations for his local identification documents.
target: Die sequenti, ad Solow Motel permanuit, praeparationes Valerii pro documentis identitatis localibus exspectans.

source: As evening approached, his messenger, Penitent Baynfel, emerged from the void and handed him a letter.
target: Vesperi accedente, nuntius eius, Penitent Baynfel, ex vacuo emergens ei epistolam tradidit.

source: Lumian glanced at the charred corpse, still engulfed in viscous black flames, and casually asked, “Who sent it?”
target: Lumian ad cadaver comburatum, adhuc in viscosis flammis nigris involutum, respexit atque leviter rogavit: "Quis id misit?"

source: Only five people were aware of his messenger’s summoning incantation.
target: Solum quinque homines incantationem vocationis nuntii eius noverunt.

source: “A woman very close to death and darkness,” Baynfel replied.
target: "Mulier ad mortem et tenebras valde appropinquata," Baynfel respondit.

source: Lumian unfolded the letter and read the familiar handwriting: “There’s a gathering scheduled for 10 tonight…”
target: Lumian epistolam explicavit et notam manu consuetam legit: "Conventus ad horam decimam hac nocte ordinatus est..."

source: This was from Hela. Before leaving Trier, Lumian had specifically summoned Hela’s messenger and informed her of his messenger’s summoning method. With his frequent travel and changes in residence, it was impractical to summon Hela’s messenger each time he stayed in a motel. Hence, he made such arrangements to convenience her in getting him.
target: Hoc a Hela erat. Prius Trier relinquens, Lumian nuntium Helae specialiter convocaverat et eam de modo vocationis nuntii sui informaverat. Propter itinerationes frequentes et mutationes domicilii, invocare nuntium Helae quoties in motel mansisset inopportunum erat. Ideo talia ordinavit ut ei convenire possent in eum convocandum.

source: Each messenger was intricately bound to its master. Through the mystical connection of the contract, the messenger could track the contracted target regardless of their changing locations.
target: Quisque nuntius arcte domino suo ligatus erat. Per nexum mysticum contractus, nuntius destinatum persequi poterat, ubicumque loca mutantur.

source: The Research Society has another gathering… Lumian dismissed Baynfel and moved to the window of the master bedroom.
target: Societas Investigationis alium conventum habet... Lumian Baynfel dimisit et ad fenestram cubiculi principali progressus est.

source: He peered into the distance, toward the mottled mountain range to the northeast.
target: Longinquus intuebatur, versus catena montium variegatorum ad septentriones.

source: Under the afterglow of the setting sun, the mountains seemed to doze in the burning sky.
target: Sub fulgore solis occurrentis, montes quasi in caelo ardenti obdormire videbantur.

source: Lumian silently observed for a moment, then retrieved the silver Lie earring and placed it on his left earlobe.
target: Lumian silentiose paulisper contemplatus est, deinde argenteum subauralium "Lie" iteravit et in lobulo auris sinistra posuit.

source: In an instant, his hair transformed, turning golden and elongating downward.
target: In momento, capilli eius transformati sunt, aurei facti et in longum deorsum extendentes.

source: At 10 p.m., in the ancient and dilapidated palace of the Nation of the Evernight, Lumian, cloaked in a black robe, hood, and a silver-white half-mask with a “Muggle” label, materialized.
target: Hora decima vespertina, in antiquo et ruinoso palatio Nationis Noctis Aeternae, Lumian, indutus veste nigra, capuce, et dimidia larva argenteo-alba cum inscriptione "Muggle", apparuit.

source: He immediately spotted Franca, who wore an Assassin suit and had pulled down her hood.
target: Statim Francam animadvertit, quae vestem sicarii gerebat et caput velamen deplexerat.

source: Franca, no longer concealing their amicable relationship, leaned in and lowered her voice.
target: Franca, iam relationem amicabilem non celans, se inclinavit atque vocem demisit.

source: “Port Santa didn’t have a Derangement outbreak, I suppose?”
target: "Portus Sanctus non habuit epidemiam perturbationis, ut opinor?"

source: “I’m not the embodiment of calamity,” Lumian replied.
target: "Non sum incarnatio calamitatis," Lumian respondit.

source: He then said to Franca, “Help me inquire in different teams later if there are any potions, charms, or items that can allow me to master a language in a short period of time—not true mastery, but the kind that allows mastery for a short period.”
target: Tum Francae dixit: "Adiuvam me in diversis coetibus postea inquirere, si qua sint potiones, charmes, aut res, quae mihi sinant linguam in brevi tempore dominari — non vere dominatio, sed genus quod temporarie regnere sinit."

source: Franca asked in confusion, “Don’t you have a translator?”
target: Franca confundens rogavit: "Num interpretem non habes?"

source: Lumian smiled and said, “It’s just that I suddenly had an idea. When everyone thinks I don’t know Highlander, I can understand what they’re talking about. Perhaps it can bring about unexpected gains.”
target: Lumian subridens dixit: "Modo repente mihi idea orta est. Cum omnes putent me linguam Highlander nescire, intellegere possum quid dicantur. Forsitan ex hoc inopinata beneficia proveniant."

source: Your scheming heart is truly stained! After Franca playfully cursed him, she wanted to praise Aurore’s beautiful lips and smile, one that ought to be seen more often, but her rationality made her give up on the idea to avoid triggering Lumian.
target: Cor insidiosum tuum vere maculatum est! Postquam Franca eum luderet maledixit, vellet oscularum et risus Aurore pulcherrimos laudare, qui saepius ostendi deberent, sed eius rationalitas eam coegit idea relinquere ne Lumian concuteretur.

source: She glanced at a corner of the palace and said, “The team most likely to obtain such items is actually the Academy. However, it’s inconvenient for you to ask. It can easily arouse suspicion. Coincidentally, I’m heading to the Academy team today to inquire if anyone knows who the owners of the ancient tombs in Trier’s catacombs are. Heh heh, many of them are considered semi-historians. If no one knows, I’ll get 007 to delve into the Church’s confidential information.”
target: Angulum palatii intuens dixit: "Turma quae verisimiliter talia res obtineat re vera Academia est. Sed tibi inquirere incommodum est; facile suspicionem excitabit. Casu, hodie ad turmam Academiae me conferam ut inquiream si quis sciat quis possideat antiqua tumula in catacumbis Trevirensibus. Heh heh, multi ex eis semi-historiographi habentur. Si nemo sciat, 007 mittam ut in res secretas Ecclesiae penetret."

source: “Why do you ask?” Lumian raised his eyebrows.
target: "Cur quaeris?" Lumian supercilia levavit.

source: Franca recounted how she and Jenna had obtained a new Mirror World Fragment in the catacombs.
target: Franca narravit quomodo ipsa et Jenna novum Fragmentum Mundi Specularis in catacumbis obtinuerunt.

source: Lumian listened attentively and scoffed.
target: Lumian attente audivit et irridens derisit.

source: “Aren’t you guys too bold? Jenna has been inspired by your courage!”
target: "Nonne estis nimis audaces? Jenna ex vestra fortitudine incitata est!"

source: As soon as he finished speaking, he saw 007 approaching menacingly.
target: Statim finito loquendo, vidit 007 minaciter accedentem.
